svg.title: What a comment links and how its feedback is counted
svg.desc: The apply job looks up the issue numbers that the AI names, up to ten: an issue or a discussion that exists stays a link, any other number becomes code. More than three links to related issues and files fold into one line below the questions, which opens them. The footer of every analysis and follow-up links the notice to reporters and asks for a thumbs up or down, and the morning sweep counts those of the last 30 days in its summary. It ends with a link to the project, unless the setting credit of the transparency section is off. Questions that stay unanswered for 15 days get a reminder that links the comment with them.
